methods.name: update
methods.summary: Updates the Google Tag Gateway configuration for a zone.
methods.description: Updates the Google Tag Gateway configuration for a zone.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Enables or disables Google Tag Gateway for this zone.

props.name: endpoint
props.description:
Specifies the endpoint path for proxying Google Tag Manager
requests. Use an absolute path starting with '/', with no nested paths and
alphanumeric characters only (e.g. /metrics).

props.name: hideOriginalIp
props.description: Hides the original client IP address from Google when enabled.

props.name: measurementId
props.description:
Specify the Google Tag Manager container or measurement ID (e.g.
GTM-XXXXXXX or G-XXXXXXXXXX).

props.name: setUpTag
props.description:
Set up the associated Google Tag on the zone automatically when
enabled.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Gets the Google Tag Gateway configuration for a zone.
